name: HiCache stack + decode kernels
configuration: 12 GB pinned host KV tier per GPU, write-through: sessions evicted from GPU KV are loaded back instead of re-prefilled (--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-size 12)
Triton extend attention tiles for FP8 KV on sm_120 (SGLANG_OPT_TRITON_EXTEND_SM120_FP8_KV_TILES=1); FP8 embedding/vocab table (SGLANG_OPT_GEMMA4_FP8_VOCAB_TABLE=1)
jumanzii's g4poc final stack on fractalyze/sglang a0491db7; alone it is dominated (0.261 GPU·s at c28, 4.69% disagreement), so it is not listed
plus the small-M FP8 weight-only GEMM for dense decode linears (SGLANG_HW_FP8_SMALL_M=1) and the small-M router GEMM (SGLANG_HW_ROUTER_SMALL_M=1), applied as two patches not published with the fork
